translation:
In the conditions of injury, dizziness of the head and eyes has some cases caused by taking too much of the attacking and reducing (克伐) formulas, so that the middle qi is injured and dizziness results; and some cases caused by excessive loss of blood, so that dizziness results. If it is accompanied by abdominal distension and vomiting, one should use Six Gentlemen Decoction (六君子湯); if accompanied by fever, thirst, and no desire for food and drink, one should use Ten Complete Great Supplementation Decoction (十全大補湯).
<ins>Six Gentlemen Decoction (六君子湯)</ins> (the formula is found under oppression and pain of the chest and abdomen, 胸腹痛悶)
<ins>Ten Complete Great Supplementation Decoction (十全大補湯)</ins> (the formula is found under diffusion and settling of stagnant blood, 瘀血泛注)
